name: Sankyu Inc.
summary: Sankyu Inc. provides logistics services in Japan and internationally. The company offers logistics solutions, such as freight, air freight, international multi-modal transport, and import and export operations; port operations, such as loading and unloading, ship agency business, packaging, port warehouse, and port base information; cargo transportation, environmental logistics, and hospital relocation work; art and event transportation, hazardous materials logistics, and waste transportation; and logistics consulting.
